glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Campfire uses a few table-specific names. These definitions note who can see each surface and whether it affects prep, live play, or campaign canon.

visibility.playerSafe: Player-safe live display; secrets stay hidden.
visibility.proposals: Drafts and suggestions do not become canon until a DM approves them.
visibility.canonGate: Pending changes wait here before they affect campaign canon.
visibility.rulesOnly: Rules reference only; it does not expose campaign secrets.
visibility.tableVisible: Shared table agreement visible to every campaign member.
visibility.dmOnly: DM-only prep space; players and viewers cannot see it.
visibility.liveCanonSplit: Acts in live play, while durable canon edits still become proposals.

cast.label: Cast
cast.short: Cast opens the /screen player or TV display: a secret-free view for the table.
cast.definition: Cast is the player/TV display at /screen. It is meant for a shared monitor and shows only player-safe live information, such as revealed encounter details, initiative, and table status.

scribe.label: Scribe
scribe.short: Scribe drafts recaps or notes into proposals; it does not write canon by itself.
scribe.definition: Scribe is the AI assistant that turns session material, inbox items, or recaps into drafts. Its output lands as proposals or previews for a human DM to review before anything becomes canon.

proposals.label: Proposals
proposals.short: Proposals are pending edits waiting for DM approval before they become canon.
proposals.definition: Proposals are suggested campaign changes from players, collaborators, Scribe, or co-DM mode. A human DM approves or rejects them; pending proposals do not change canon.

compendium.label: Compendium
compendium.short: Compendium is the searchable rules reference, separate from campaign secrets.
compendium.definition: Compendium is the installed rules reference for monsters, spells, items, and other game content. It supports play and prep without revealing DM-only campaign notes.

sessionZero.label: Session Zero
sessionZero.short: Session Zero is the shared table agreement for safety, tone, and house rules.
sessionZero.definition: Session Zero records the table's agreed boundaries, safety tools, tone, and house rules. Everyone in the campaign can read it; DMs maintain it.

storylines.label: Storylines
storylines.short: Storylines are DM-only prep for arcs, beats, and branches.
storylines.definition: Storylines are a DM-only planning space for arcs, beats, branches, and future reveals. They are prep material and can contain secrets players should not see.

coDm.label: co-DM
coDm.short: co-DM proposes changes for a human DM; it never applies canon directly.
coDm.definition: co-DM is the AI assist mode where the AI asks instead of acts. It drafts suggestions and proposals, then a human DM decides what becomes canon.

driver.label: Driver
driver.short: Driver lets the AI run live play directly, while canon edits still go through proposals.
driver.definition: Driver is the AI mode where the AI holds the DM seat for live play: narrating, rolling dice, applying HP and conditions, and advancing turns within its budget. Durable canon edits such as new NPCs, quests, or locations still become proposals for DM review.
